### Observed differences

- In the later window, A20, A22 and A23 occur earlier in the trace: their mean event position falls from about 64-65% to about 39% of trace length, while A25 and A29 occur later (A25 from about 39% to 45%; A29 from about 58% to 64%). [POS003, POS005, POS006, POS008, POS009]
- The relative order between these groups reversed: before, A25 and A29 almost always preceded A20, A22 and A23 in co-occurring traces (about 97-99 in 100); after, A20, A22 and A23 almost always precede A25 and A29 (about 97-99 in 100). [REL023, REL024, REL030, REL031, REL033, REL034]
- A19, A21 and A24 also occur later: their mean event position rises from about 36-37% to about 67%, and their order relative to A20, A22, A23, A25 and A29 shifts from before to after (for example, A19 before A20/A22/A23/A25/A29 in about 29-30 in 100 traces before, versus A20/A22/A23/A25/A29 before A19 in about 31-33 in 100 traces after). [POS002, POS004, POS007, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL032, REL035, REL036]
- A08 becomes less frequent and less tightly linked to A16 and later activities: trace participation falls from about 64 in 100 to 29 in 100, its mean event position rises from about 26% to 41%, co-occurrence with A14, A15, A16, A20, A22, A23, A25, A29, A30, A40, A45 and A46 falls from about 64 in 100 to 29 in 100, A08 before A20/A22/A23/A25/A29 falls from about 56-59 in 100 to about 17-26 in 100, and, among observed A08-A16 pairs within five steps, distance 1 falls from about 99 in 100 to 43 in 100. [OCC003, POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL005, REL007, REL008, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, LAG001]
- A04, A06 and A10 become more frequent: trace participation rises from about 7-9 in 100 to about 19-24 in 100; among observed outgoing transitions, A04 and A10 shift toward A15, A22, A23, A44 and A46. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR001, DIR003]
- A15's outgoing transitions shift from A16 and A08 to almost always A16: A16 rises from about 61 in 100 to 88 in 100, A08 falls from about 39 in 100 to 7 in 100, and, among observed A15-A16 pairs within five steps, distance 1 rises from about 18 in 100 to 34 in 100. [DIR005, LAG010]
- A19, A21 and A24 now lead to A30 instead of A25: A19 followed by A30 is about 95 in 100 after versus A19 followed by A25 about 95 in 100 before; A21 followed by A30 is about 92 in 100 after versus A21 followed by A25 about 93 in 100 before; A24 followed by A30 is about 97 in 100 after versus A24 followed by A25 about 97 in 100 before. [DIR006, DIR008, DIR011]
- A08's outgoing transitions shift from almost always A16 to a spread of successors: A16 falls from about 93 in 100 to 31 in 100, while A15, A44, A20 and A23 become more visible as successors. [DIR002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

- The evidence supports the possibility that the relative order of two groups of activities was reversed: in the later window, A20, A22 and A23 occur before A19, A21, A24, A25 and A29 in co-occurring traces, whereas in the earlier window A25 and A29, and to a lesser extent A19, A21 and A24, occurred before A20, A22 and A23. [POS003, POS005, POS006, POS008, POS009, REL023, REL024, REL030, REL031, REL033, REL034, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL032, REL035, REL036]
- The supporting signs are direct and consistent: near-complete order reversals for A20/A22/A23 versus A25/A29, matching event-position shifts for these activities, and repeated relational evidence for A19, A21 and A24. [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, REL031, REL032, REL033, REL034, REL035, REL036]
- A limitation is that the windows are finite samples and the evidence does not identify the cause; the optional activities A19, A21 and A24 have lower trace support (about 30-40 in 100) than the mandatory A20, A22, A23, A25 and A29. [POS002, POS004, POS007, POS003, POS005, POS006, POS008, POS009]
- A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that the reordering is accompanied by a change in case mix or path selection, such as A08 becoming less frequent and A04/A06/A10 becoming more frequent, rather than being a standalone position swap. [OCC003, OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, REL001, REL005, REL007, REL008, REL010, REL011]

Other differences:

- A08 becomes less frequent, later, and less tightly coupled to A16 and later activities. [OCC003, POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL005, REL007, REL008, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, LAG001, DIR002]
- A04, A06 and A10 become more frequent, with A04 and A10 showing new or stronger outgoing links to A15, A22, A23, A44 and A46. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR001, DIR003]
- A15 becomes more directly followed by A16 and less often by A08. [DIR005, LAG010]
- A19, A21 and A24 lead to A30 instead of A25. [DIR006, DIR008, DIR011]
